description.en: Long stalks support four-part clover-like water-fern leaves.
description.zh: 长叶柄支撑四片小叶构成的三叶草状水生蕨叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Marsilea; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Marsilea 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Four leaflets on single petioles differ from pinnate ferns and scale-leaved floating Azolla.
distinctness.zh: 单柄四小叶区别于羽状蕨及鳞片叶浮生满江红。

modeling_brief.en: Use a restrained creeping base with repeated four-blade fans; water level and leaf tilt are art choices.
modeling_brief.zh: 以简约匍匐基部和重复四叶扇建形；水位与叶倾角为美术选择。

uncertainty: Eocene foliage anchors the concept; sporocarps and full rooting detail need additional specimens.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Occurrence and paleoecology of Marsilea from the Eocene Wasatch Formation
